title: How is the initial session different from regular sessions?
metaTitle: Understanding Initial vs. Regular Therapy Sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover the differences between initial and regular therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network. Learn how the initial session involves evaluation to develop a custom treatment plan, while regular sessions focus on implementing the treatment plan and working towards set goals.
html: The initial session typically involves a detailed evaluation of the child’s abilities and needs. This assessment allows therapists to develop a custom treatment plan. In regular sessions, the therapists implement this plan and work towards set goals.
